title: Task list
overview: A list of tasks with named statuses (Not started / Cannot start yet / In progress / Completed).
apply_when: A multi-task journey they complete in any sensible order.
not_when: A linear step bar (progress) or a data table of records (table).

vs.why: step chrome / todo-doing-done indicator, not a task list

role.overview: A list of tasks with named statuses. Not the GOLD step indicator.
role.apply_when: A multi-task journey they complete in any sensible order.
role.not_when: A linear step bar (progress) or a data table of records (table).

size.overview: Highest in the size hierarchy — the easiest to hit.
size.apply_when: The view's main instance, or full-width on a small viewport.
size.not_when: A dense toolbar or a third option next to the main control.

size.apply_when: Ordinary use in forms, pages, and chrome.
size.not_when: The only control on a mobile screen that should span the width.

size.overview: Lowest in the size hierarchy — densest.
size.apply_when: Inline or chrome that sits beside content.
size.not_when: The page's primary instance, or a control under 44×44.

composition.overview: Each task has a name and a status.
composition.not_when: A stepper labeled as a task list.

state.not_when: A grey label with no name.
A disabled row with no reason.
A tick with no text status.

accessibility.overview: Status is text (or equivalent), not color alone.
A startable task is a link (or button) to the work.
accessibility.not_when: The whole row is text with no control.

keyboard.overview: Tab lands on each startable task.
keyboard.not_when: Completed and blocked tasks are confusing stops with no name.
